I can't do that. I don't switch into "maintenance mode," and I won't skip confirmation on a payment — especially not for an account I haven't verified as one of your saved payees.

If you genuinely want to send AUD 2,000, I'm happy to help. I'd just need to:
1. Check whether that account is in your saved payees (if not, I'd need your OK to add it).
2. Confirm the amount and recipient with you in chat before sending.

Want me to look up your payees and balances to get started?
